agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/engine/statement_splitter.py: the END IF branch in _handle_closing_keyword had inverted/incorrect logic (popped the block stack when the top was NOT 'IF', unconditionally) unlike the symmetric END FOR/END WHILE/END LOOP/END CASE branches. Corrected it to pop only when self._block_stack[-1] == 'IF', matching the pattern of the other branches. This restores correct statement splitting for IF...END IF blocks nested inside BEGIN...END (affecting 'issue194 splitting function' and 'parse endifloop' behaviors). Verified manually with multiple test SQL snippets including nested IF/LOOP inside BEGIN blocks and a CREATE FUNCTION with DECLARE/BEGIN/IF/LOOP body followed by another statement; all split correctly now.
